itemdesc-mosssigil: A pad of pressed living moss. Right-click to write a small circle on it, hold right-click then release to cast it, sneak + right-click to edit it.
itemdesc-barksigil: A flattened piece of bark. Right-click to write a circle on it, hold right-click then release to cast it, sneak + right-click to edit it.
itemdesc-parchmentsigil: A scraped, stretched sheet of hide. Room for a full circle with its aim ring. Right-click to write on it, hold right-click then release to cast it, sneak + right-click to edit it.
itemdesc-devbook: Creative-mode tool for server operators. Right-click to write a circle from named glyphs, on any medium, without drawing it.
canvas-hint:
Circle: click a slot to select it, drag between two glyphs to link them, drag with right-click to unlink them, scroll over a glyph to write it more or less strongly, click the border to choose where its life comes from.
Glyph: hold and sweep across points to draw, sweep with right-click to erase. Click a point to cycle its mark, right-click to clear it.
canvas-empty: Write at least one glyph before inscribing.
inscribe-no-medium: Hold what you want to write on.
cast-cooldown: Your hand is still trembling from the last working.
cast-fizzle: The circle smoulders and crumbles. Nothing answers.
cast-backfire: The circle bursts in your hand!
command-inspect: Show how the server reads the circle on the medium in your hand (spoilers!)
command-glyphs: Open a window showing this world's glyphs (spoilers!)
error-in-game-only: Run this in game, not from the console.
error-script-not-ready: The world's script is not ready yet.
inspect-out-of-bounds: Out of bounds for this tier: casting does nothing.
mishap-hint-overload: A heart is too strong for this medium: its glyph sizes add up past {0}. Use smaller element glyphs.
mishap-hint-oversized: A form is too large for this medium: its glyph sizes add up past {1}. Use smaller form glyphs.
mishap-hint-toomanyspells: Too many spells for this medium: it holds {2}. Link glyphs into fewer hearts or form groups.
mishap-hint-unknown: A linked figure is no glyph. Check its lines and marks, or remove it.
mishap-hint-opposition: Opposing glyphs were linked together. Keep them apart.
mishap-hint-misplaced: A glyph sits on the wrong ring: elements belong in the heart, forms on the ring around it.
mishap-hint-noelement: Nothing to cast: write at least one element in the heart.
mishap-hint-nomix: Some linked glyphs mix into nothing. Try another combination, or unlink them.
